$schema_note: Canonical material palette for Open Rails. This file is the single source of truth for asset colours; .agents/references/material-palette.md mirrors it for humans and must be updated in the same change if the two disagree. Colours are sRGB hex. Geometry inside the GLB stores LINEAR-interpreted vertex colours: exporters/tools convert sRGB->linear on write and linear->sRGB on read.

glass_fake.note: windows; stylized opaque, mild emission ok

vertex_colour.note: Every opaque surface in every asset uses this single shared material; colour comes from the mesh colour attribute, never from material parameters.

company_colour.note: Shared parameterised company livery material. Baked as two export instances so the runtime can tint each livery region independently with one material override per instance.

water.note: The one sanctioned transparent material; terrain water surfaces only, never authored into asset GLBs.
